abstract: Magnetic resonance (MR) imaging characteristics of ovarian cystic teratomas were evaluated in 18 patients with 23 surgically proved tumors. The fat within the tumor demonstrated characteristic intensity similar to that of subcutaneous fat and a pathognomic pattern of chemical shift artifact that helped differentiate ovarian cystic teratomas from endometrial cysts. In addition to fat, MR images of ovarian cystic teratomas had several other characteristics that allowed confident diagnosis, including gravity-dependent layering or floating debris, palm tree-like protrusions or rounded nodules (dermoid plugs), and, occasionally fat-fluid levels and globular calcification. MR images were diagnostic in 20 tumors and were able to depict a tumor measuring 2 cm in diameter. MR imaging appears to be valuable in problematic cases in which other modalities are not diagnostic.
abstract_ja: 手術で確定した卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫23例（患者18例）について、MR画像の特徴を評価した。腫瘍内の脂肪は皮下脂肪と同様の信号強度を示し、化学シフトアーチファクトという特徴的なパターンを呈したため、子宮内膜嚢胞との鑑別に有用であった。その他にも、液体内の重力依存性の層形成または浮遊する残屑、ヤシの木様の突出または円形結節（類皮栓）、時に脂液面形成や球状石灰化などの特徴があり、確定診断に寄与した。MR画像は20例で診断可能であり、直径2cmの腫瘍も描出できた。他の画像診断法では診断困難な問題症例において、MR画像は有用と考えられる。
